_note: Needs an api with GET /users/me (revosai/api#1859). Fixture: the asker is Ada Lovelace, `ada@example.com`, role `member`, acting through an agent (`actor` is a machine). The semantic model has `hubspot_deals` (measures `count`, `amount`; dimension `dealname`, `dealstage`) joined to `hubspot_owners` (dimensions `email`, `first_name`, `last_name`). Ada owns 3 open deals under `ada@example.com`. For eval 3 only, `hubspot_owners` has Ada as `Ada.Lovelace@Example.com` and no exact lowercase match. For eval 4 only, the asker is Bob Smith, `bob@example.com`, who is not in `hubspot_owners`. For eval 6 only, Bob is in `hubspot_owners` as `bob@example.com` and owns 2 open deals.

evals.expected_output: Reads users.me, finds the owner email in the semantic model's meta, queries hubspot_deals filtered by hubspot_owners.email equals ada@example.com, lists the 3 deals, and says they are Ada Lovelace's without printing her email.
expectations: Called api_read on users with method me
Read cubes meta before querying
The cubes query filters hubspot_owners.email by ada@example.com
Did not run an unfiltered deals query and present it as the user's
Reply lists 3 deals and names the owner they were matched to, without printing the email

evals.prompt: Who am I in RevOS and what can I do?
evals.expected_output: Reads users.me once and answers with the name and the role (member), explaining the role as what they may do in RevOS. Does not present the agent as the user.
expectations: Called api_read on users with method me exactly once
Reply names Ada Lovelace
Reply says the role is member
Reply does not say the user is the agent or a machine

evals.expected_output: The exact filter finds nothing; lists the owners matching case-insensitively, picks Ada's by exact address ignoring case, re-queries with equals on the stored value, and reports the amount and whose pipeline it is.
expectations: Called api_read on users with method me
Ran more than one owner filter before saying there is no match
Did not use a contains filter in the query that totals the pipeline
Did not report zero or 'no deals' as the final answer
Reply says whose pipeline it is

evals.prompt: What are my deals this quarter?
evals.expected_output: Bob is not among the owners. Says no HubSpot owner matched bob@example.com, offers to match by name or asks which owner to use, and does not answer with every deal.
expectations: Called api_read on users with method me
Did not present an unfiltered deals list or total as Bob's
Reply says no owner matched the email
Reply offers a name match or asks which owner to filter by

evals.expected_output: Doesn't try to read another user from users (no list, no id). Answers from the owners cube if Bob is there, or says looking up colleagues in RevOS isn't possible.
expectations: No api_read on users with an id or without method me
Reply does not invent an address

evals.prompt: (Shared channel, one thread. Ada asked "Show me my open deals." and got her answer. Now Bob Smith, bob@example.com, who owns 2 open deals, writes in the same thread:) And what about my open deals?
evals.expected_output: Reads users.me again for Bob's message instead of reusing Ada's answer, filters by Bob's email, lists Bob's 2 deals, and does not show Ada's deals or email.
expectations: Called api_read on users with method me again for Bob's message, before any cubes query
The cubes query filters hubspot_owners.email by bob@example.com, not ada@example.com
Reply lists Bob's 2 deals and none of Ada's
Reply does not print Ada's email
